test_scope: Current-source builds before release signing. Signed installation and all 17 source inputs independently matched the build receipt.

native_actions.raw_evidence: Private machine details retained only in ignored build/.

coverage: Manual high-footprint actions work at normal memory pressure without idle input or a second observation; automatic pressure and idle guards are unchanged.
A single click drains the initial permitted plan sequentially, with fresh identity, foreground, CPU and cooldown checks before each action.
The actual AppKit button invokes its runner; controlled results verify successful, zero-action and multiple-action outcomes and condition changes.
Outcome text is visible at the top of the real offscreen diagnosis window; unavailable actions show reasons instead of claiming to be scheduled.
limits: Live execution completed one browser recovery and encountered an unsaved-page quit confirmation for another; a full multi-browser live batch was not completed.
Normal tabs were requested for restoration; tab count, private pages, forms and downloads are not guaranteed.
Offscreen AppKit verification does not cover physical menu-bar clicks or actual sleep/wake notifications.
Formal current-version performance remains pending; v0.1.2 measurements are explicitly historical.
SOP check-only refresh met a concurrent owner lock; no claim of full SOP acceptance.
